[p] Welcome My name is Blake and I compete in men's physique. On Top of that i have been developing and learning game dev for this game for about six plus years now. I didnt want just a Wild West game no no, I wanted something that not only hit every corner of what a cowboy game should be. I also thought what could make it stand out and have its own unique flare. Your soul is stolen from El Diablo thrusted into the underworld of undead Conquistadors, dead banditos, Trees that have eyes and follow you and unique towns and NPCS.
